title: PRISM: Transfer and Limits of Activation Interventions in Tool-Calling Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.20808v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Recent literature shows that unsafe tool calls can often accompany textual refusals in language models. To investigate this hidden vulnerability, we introduce PRISM, a framework for evaluating the transfer of activation interventions across precision, languages, and scales. Our findings demonstrate that leveraging lower-resource settings (specifically quantized NF4 labels and cross-lingual transfer) offers a robust pathway to expose and improve model alignment. Notably, using behavioral labels from an NF4 copy enables stable intervention estimation even with very few scenarios. Furthermore, these alignment improvements transfer effectively across languages: five-language NF4-supervised directions successfully transfer to held-out Arabic, reducing unsafe violations in Llama-3.1-8B by 21.95 percentage points without target-language tuning. translated_title: PRISM：工具调用语言模型中激活干预的迁移与局限
translated_abstract: 近期文献表明，语言模型中不安全的工具调用常常伴随着文本层面的拒绝。为了研究这一隐藏漏洞，我们提出了PRISM，一个用于评估激活干预在不同精度、语言和规模之间迁移情况的框架。我们的研究结果表明，利用低资源设置（特别是量化NF4标签和跨语言迁移）为暴露和改进模型对齐提供了一条可靠的途径。值得注意的是，使用来自NF4副本的行为标签，即使只有极少量的场景也能实现稳定的干预估计。此外，这些对齐改进能够有效地跨语言迁移：由五种语言监督的NF4方向成功迁移到保留测试的阿拉伯语上，在无需目标语言调优的情况下，将Llama-3.1-8B中的不安全违规减少了21.95个百分点。通过映射成对的良性激活，我们还成功地将这些安全干预迁移到……（摘要原文在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PRISM框架，证明利用量化NF4标签和跨语言迁移等低资源设置即可稳定估计激活干预方向，并将安全对齐改进跨语言迁移到阿拉伯语等保留语言，在无需目标语言调优的情况下将Llama-3.1-8B的不安全工具调用违规减少21.95个百分点。
